name: Cordless Bond
description: Bind a soul with no cord at all so that the hold is felt but cannot be cut.

name: Unseen Yoke
description: Lay a yoke on a soul that no sense can find and that bears down on its force.

name: Fortress Knot
description: Tie the fortress of the soul into a knot that holds against any soul-strike.

name: Binding Reach
description: Reach out with a binding no distance weakens and close it on a far soul.

name: Unlimited Hold
description: Hold every soul in sight at once with a grip that does not tire.

name: Sundered Intent
description: Cut the line between an opponent's will and its technique so that the technique cannot form.

name: Pinioned Spirit
description: Pinion an opponent's soul so that all its techniques stay shut and its force pools useless.

name: Mirrored Fetter
description: Turn every binding laid on the student back on the one who laid it.

name: Supreme Cinch
description: Cinch the school's great knot on a soul so that it is held and sealed beyond the reach of any lesser soul to free.

name: Host Knot
description: Tie a knot into the souls of a whole host so that they stand or fall as one.

name: Knot Cataclysm
description: Draw a knot through a vast stretch of ground so that every soul in it is held and crushed up to the ruinous ceiling of a Core-tier soul.

name: Unbound Knot
description: Tie a knot that needs no cord and no touch and binds a soul by the bare fact of the tying so that the soul stays held wherever it flees and no strength can loosen it; each use is a Part 27 consequence event.
